notes.title: Bulletorium: Gamepad + more AI control
notes.content:
[h1]Gamepad input added[/h1]

Now you can use gamepad for game. Just press any button on gamepad / keyboard to switch between mouse+keyboard and gamepad control. Check tutorial and in-game tooltips for control.

[h1]In-game tooltips[/h1]
In-game tooltips added for gamepad and keyboard actions. It includes menues (for gamepad), tactic mode and AI orders menu (tooltips on hud), construction tooltips (in tactic mode) etc. Also tutorial added to pause menu, so you can check it witouht leaving a battle.

[h1]Tactic mode changed[/h1]
Now game is paused in tactic mode. You any time you need to coordinate your battle planes.

[h1]AI orders[/h1]
AI orders menu have few orders for AI which together with pause in tactic mode will help you to better controll AI:
[list]
[*] "Drones in radius to me" - all drones in close radius around the player will move to his last location and then they will continue to previous tasks (may be helpful to avoind battles and stubbing enemyes in back)
[*] "Drones in radius to closest base" - all drones in close around the player radius will rush to closest enemy base for player
[*] "All drones to closest base" - all drones on map will rush to closest enemy base for player
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
Borders on some levels were changed for better AI movement
Complexity of some levels was decreased, specially for first levels

[h1]Saving[/h1]
The save system has been improved, but the new system is incompatible with the old saves, so they will be overwritten. I apologize for this issue, it will not happen again in the future
